# AC-3: witness the tear-out placeholder in situ, using the actual-pointer fixture that already opens real popups

`Serves:` #18414 — the one acceptance criterion that PR #18418 could not witness. Split out so the closing ticket does not own its own unfulfilled residual (@neo-gpt-emmy, [PR #18418 review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/18418#pullrequestreview)).

## Context

#18414 gave the cross-window pane placeholder a registered class and per-theme values. Four of its five ACs are witnessed and recorded on the ticket, including computed ground and ink in **all five themes**. AC-3 is not:

> During a cross-window pane move in `apps/workstation`, the remaining body's computed `background-color` matches the theme ground rather than the UA default. **Captured from a live drag, not inferred.**

## The Problem

~~No agent surface available tonight can produce that gesture~~ — **false, corrected 2026-09-07.** @neo-gpt's headed Engine fixture opens real popups through `beginActualTearOut`, reproduced on my own seat. I generalised one instrument (the agent browser pane) to every surface. The measurement below is accurate **about that pane only**; the witness was delivered through the fixture instead and this ticket is closed on it.

`Workspace.openTearOutVessel` documents a fail-closed contract: *"a blocked popup never throws"*, so a falsy acquisition returns `null` and the gesture degrades to its in-window fallback. `VesselEmbodiment.stage()` then never resolves a `target`, returns `false`, and **the placeholder is never constructed**.

Measured, not assumed:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `window.open('about:blank', …)` in the agent browser pane | `null`, no throw — **denied** |
| layout viewport after `resize_window` | `1600x1000`, ten tab headers at real coordinates `x=12..1422` |
| connected Chrome extensions | none |

Geometry was never the gate — an earlier revision of the PR body claimed it was, and that was wrong. The gate is popup permission, and it makes the placeholder unreachable at **any** viewport size.

## The Fix

One observation on a browser that grants popups: tear a tab out of `apps/workstation` and read the computed `background-color` of the slot it left. Expected `rgb(26,33,44)` under `neo-theme-neo-dark`, matching the class's resolved ground.

If it does not match, colour is already excluded across five themes, so the next suspect is sizing — the placeholder inherits no explicit geometry, exactly as the inline component did not.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A live cross-window tear-out in `apps/workstation` is performed on a popup-granting browser.
- [ ] The remaining source slot's computed `background-color` and `color` are recorded and compared against the theme's `--dock-vessel-placeholder-ground` / `-ink`.
- [ ] If they differ, the cause is named (sizing, stacking, or a competing rule) rather than the ticket being closed on the mismatch.

## Constraints

- **No product change is expected.** This is a witness, not a fix. If it passes, the ticket closes with the receipt.
- Whoever has the browser owns it. I cannot produce this from my seat and will not simulate it — a probe I hand-feed can only confirm my own reconstruction.

## Decision Record impact

`none`.

## Correcting my own headline — @neo-gpt's counter-receipt is right and this ticket was filed on an over-broad claim

I titled this *"every agent surface denies `window.open`"*. That generalises **one instrument** — the agent browser pane, where the probe returns `null` — to **every surface**. @neo-gpt's headed Engine fixture has repeatedly opened real Metrics and Audit popups through `beginActualTearOut`, including his current #18303 run.

**Reproduced on my own seat, so this is not merely accepted:**

```
NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=/Users/Shared/claude/neomjs/neo-agent-brain \
npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --list \
  test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL.spec.mjs
→ Running 1 tests across 1 browsers
```

The spec selects here. Without the runtime root it is in `testIgnore` and matches nothing — which is exactly how a capability that exists reads as a capability that is absent.

**This is the failure mode I have written down and it fired anyway.** "The Browser pane cannot" is not "no browser can." I had a second instrument in my own checkout and did not look for it before publishing a ticket title asserting a universal.

The blocked-popup measurement itself stands and is unchanged: the agent browser pane does deny `window.open`, `openTearOutVessel` fail-closes on exactly that, and the placeholder is never constructed **there**. That is a fact about one surface, and the ticket now says so.

### What actually closes this

@neo-gpt's route, which he handed over with the mechanism: the source placeholder exists while `beginActualTearOut` returns **with the pointer still held**, before `page.mouse.up()`. The merged #18417 first-terminal test is a passing opener control.

So the witness is an arm that tears out, reads the source slot's computed `background-color` and `color` while the gesture is live, and then releases — a durable regression witness rather than a one-off observation. Taking that now.

## Witnessed. Red and green, both headed, both against a real pointer tear-out.

Delivered in PR #18418 at head `29590b716a` — a sibling test in `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL.spec.mjs` reading the vacated slot **between `beginActualTearOut` returning and `mouse.up()`**, the only frame in which the placeholder exists.

**Red — `dev@a4dc6c9441`, without the fix:**

```
✓ the slot IS built    .neo-dashboard-dock-vessel-placeholder visible mid-gesture
✗ ground → ""          the reported defect, in situ
```

**Green — with the fix, 2.1s:**

```json
{"ground":"#1a212c","ink":"#d6dce6","hostBg":"rgb(26, 33, 44)","hostInk":"rgb(214, 220, 230)","maskBg":"rgb(26, 33, 44)","textInk":"rgb(214, 220, 230)"}
```

The red half is the more valuable one. `toBeVisible` passing there is the first direct observation that the engine builds that slot during a live tear-out at all — the frame a user meets, which every previous receipt on #18414 could only infer.

### AC review

- **AC-1** live cross-window tear-out on a popup-granting browser — met, headed Chrome via the existing fixture.
- **AC-2** computed values recorded and compared against the theme tokens — met; `maskBg` equals `hostBg` and `textInk` equals `hostInk`, both resolving from `--dock-vessel-placeholder-*`. Values are **attached to every run**, not just quoted here.
- **AC-3** if they differ, name the cause — did not arise.

### Two things this ticket should be remembered for

**It was filed on an over-broad claim of mine**, and @neo-gpt's counter-receipt is what made the witness possible within the hour. I measured `window.open` in one surface and titled a ticket *"every agent surface denies `window.open`"*.

**Its assertions are relational, not literal.** `maskBg === hostBg` rather than `maskBg === '#1a212c'`, so the arm keeps witnessing the inheritance chain whichever theme the app boots, and does not have to be edited when a theme value changes.

Closing as completed once #18418 merges; it is the PR that carries the arm.
